transfer.visualRole: supporting-content: regulatory-registration-as-credibility copy and layout pattern for a restrained single-claim page
principles: Regulatory proof, a CVR number, a Danish FSA registration ID, and named compliance documents, is stated as plain, undecorated fact text in a fixed footer position rather than dramatized - confirms that for an institutional or regulated audience, a real registration number stated plainly outperforms a badge graphic.

The page commits to exactly one message per screen, brand meaning, then contact, then registration, rather than stacking multiple competing claims - directly informs why UNIENS' proof strip should isolate license, patent, and GMP facts into their own dedicated section rather than blending them into the hero.
No stock imagery or generic hero photograph anywhere on the page; the entire credibility case rests on restrained typography and factual registration text.
